title: Telur Dilarang Sampai Jumat
subject: Asep, a ninth-grader in Tasikmalaya, avoids eggs, bananas and washing his lucky socks all exam week, while Bu Titin at the school-gate warung renames her menu so he can still eat
caption: Sundanese angklung acoustic pop, bouncy two-step pulse. Tuned angklung playing a bright interlocking riff, strummed steel-string acoustic guitar, light kendang on the off-beats, plucked upright bass, group hand claps on the chorus. Airy open-room recording, dry drums, light slap echo on the angklung. Female vocal, bright mid register, cheerful teasing delivery, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, G major. Playful and bouncy mood. No electric guitar, no synths, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rap, no heavy reverb.
lyrics:
[Intro - angklung riff, claps]

[Verse 1]
Senin pagi Asep sudah berpantang
Telur bulat itu katanya nol
Pisang juga tidak, takut terpeleset
Kaus kaki keberuntungan tak dicuci

[Pre-Chorus]
Bu Titin di warung geleng kepala
Dia tulis menu baru di papan

[Chorus]
Nasi telur jadi nasi bintang kuning
Pisang goreng jadi jalan lurus
Asep makan lahap sambil mengangguk
Semua yang bulat, tolong jangan sebut

[Verse 2]
Rabu bau kaus kakinya sampai ke kelas
Teman sebangku pindah ke baris belakang
Pak Guru buka jendela lebar-lebar
Asep tetap duduk, bangga dan tegar

[Pre-Chorus]
Kamis pagi Bu Titin berbisik
Nilaimu bukan urusan kaus kakimu

[Chorus]
Nasi bintang kuning, jalan lurus
Asep makan lahap sambil mengangguk
Kaus kaki ini sampai Jumat
Semua yang bulat, jangan dulu disebut

[Bridge - angklung alone]
Jumat siang pensil diletakkan
Dia cium kaus kakinya, lalu menyesal

[Chorus]
Bu Titin, telur dadar dua!
Pisang goreng juga, jangan lupa
Asep makan lahap sambil mengangguk
Kaus kakinya akhirnya mandi

[Outro - angklung riff, claps]
